technical_commentary: MRPL's monthly chart shows a severe 2024-25 Stage-4 decline (Rs 277 ATH Feb'24 to Rs 104 Feb'25) giving way to a volatile recovery base since Aug'25: price now sits above rising 6/10-month MAs, but the push to a marginal new high of Rs 207 on 16-Mar-26 came on the two heaviest volume days in five years (14.5Cr and 8.7Cr shares) followed by a same-month reversal to Rs 180 - a buying-climax signature - and the slide to Rs 145 by May'26 undercut the prior swing low, consistent with Choppiness Index readings stuck in the 50s versus ~40 during the genuinely clean 2023 markup. The 20-month MA has only just flattened and the bounce back to Rs 173 is running on expanding volume (1.6x the prior six months), so this reads as contested re-accumulation rather than dead drift, but remains an unconfirmed Stage-1-to-2 transition - wait-for-resolution through the Rs 193-207 supply zone, not an actionable breakout today.
